title: Choose decimal precision and special-value behavior
goal: Choose System.Decimal or IEEE decimal floating point when accumulating base-ten measurements with an explicit precision and nonfinite-value policy.

selectionNotes: IEEE Decimal32/64/128 provide 7/16/34 significant decimal digits; they are not System.Decimal.
